title: HOW TO 04: What to Never Paste into an AI Chat
label: HOW TO 04
banner: What to never paste into AI

lines.text: Three years, or seventy-two hours. [1] Ravi just pasted his customers' dues list into Gemini.

lines.text: Gemini, on the website: Settings and help, then Activity. [1] Click the word On, then Turn off. [2] Your history stops saving. Or use a temporary chat.
lines.show: Gemini, on the website: Settings and help, then Activity. Click the word On, then Turn off. Your history stops saving. Or use a temporary chat.

lines.text: In ChatGPT: Settings, Data controls, [1] turn off "Improve the model for everyone". It's on by default. [2] Temporary Chat works there too.

lines.text: The switch covers new chats, and a chat already reviewed stays. [1] So the real fix: paste "Customer 1", never names or phone numbers.
